# TrustLLM

> A release gate for LLM answers. Write guardrail rules, check answers against a source text, and get PASS or FAIL with plain-language reasons and suggested fixes. Browser app, CLI, GitHub Action and MCP server. MIT licensed, no account, no telemetry. Demo mode is offline and labelled; live mode uses the caller's own provider key.

Important facts for agents:
- Demo mode results are produced by deterministic stand-ins and word-matching heuristics. They are not measurements of any real model.
- API keys are never stored or logged. The web API accepts a key per request and only provider presets, not arbitrary URLs.
- Exit codes of the CLI and Action: 0 gate passed, 1 gate failed, 2 error.

## Use it
- [Web app](/dashboard): evaluate answers, edit guardrails, history, export, share links
- [Documentation](/docs): first run, CLI, GitHub Action, score meanings, rule types, privacy, limits
- Health and capabilities: GET /api/health
- Evaluate: POST /api/evaluate with JSON {mode, cases[{prompt, context?, answer?}], models[{provider, model, apiKey?, preset?}], judge?, samples?, rules?}; returns a trustllm.report/v1 JSON report

## Integrate
- CLI: `node dist/cli.cjs run trustllm.yaml` (init, run, mcp). `init --pack support-bot|rag-strict|structured-output|safety-first|try-it-lenient`
- MCP server: `node dist/cli.cjs mcp` (stdio). Tools: evaluate, list_packs, list_rule_types
- GitHub Action: `uses: Professional50coder/trustllm@main` with `config:`; optional `comment: true` posts the report on pull requests
